title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
benefit: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank accounts in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names, subject to statutory exclusion criteria (e.g. constitutional post holders, institutional landholders, income tax payers).
exclusions: Institutional landholders, serving or retired government officers/employees, individuals who paid income tax in last assessment year, doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs.
how_to_apply_steps: 1. Verify that your Aadhaar card is linked to your bank account and active mobile number.
2. Have your latest land ownership record (Khatauni) and Aadhaar number ready.
3. Open the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and locate the 'Farmers Corner' section.
4. Click on 'New Farmer Registration', select Rural or Urban, and enter your Aadhaar and mobile number.
5. Enter the OTP received, fill your state, district, sub-district, village, and survey/khasra land numbers.
6. Submit the application, save the registration reference number, and track status via 'Beneficiary Status' on the portal.

title: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
department: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare
benefit: Comprehensive crop insurance covering non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests, post-harvest losses). Farmers pay nominal premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible for coverage.
exclusions: Losses arising out of war, nuclear risks, malicious damage, preventable pest neglect, or theft are excluded.
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Land Revenue Receipt
Sowing Certificate / Declaration issued by Patwari / Village Officer
Bank Account details (Passbook copy with IFSC)
Tenant agreement / Land lease contract (for tenant farmers)
how_to_apply_steps: 1. Ensure the crop being grown is a notified crop for your district in the current season.
2. Obtain a Sowing Certificate or self-declaration counter-signed by the local agriculture department/patwari.
3. Visit the official PMFBY National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in).
4. Click on 'Farmer Corner' -> 'Apply for Crop Insurance by yourself' or visit your bank branch / nearest CSC center.
5. Fill in crop details, area sown in hectares, bank account details, and upload supporting land records.
6. Pay the farmer share of the premium online or via your Kisan Credit Card bank account before the cut-off date (usually July 31 for Kharif, Dec 31 for Rabi).
application_mode: Online Portal, Commercial Banks, RRBs, CSCs

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Adequate and timely institutional credit up to ₹3 Lakhs at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive of 3% on 7% base rate). Flexible withdrawal and repayment tied to harvest cycles.
eligibility: All individual farmers/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers.
exclusions: Defaulters with outstanding non-performing loans in other commercial banks until rectified.
documents: Proof of identity: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card
Proof of address: Aadhaar Card / Electricity Bill / Ration Card
Land record documents certified by revenue authority
how_to_apply_steps: 1. Download the one-page simplified KCC application form from the official PM-KISAN or NABARD portal.
2. Fill in basic personal details, PM-KISAN beneficiary status ID, landholding details, and requested credit limit.
3. Attach copies of Aadhaar, land records (Khatauni), and latest land tax receipt.
4. Submit the physical form to your nearest nationalized, regional rural (RRB), or cooperative bank branch.
5. Alternatively, apply through digital agricultural lending platforms offered by SBI YONO Krishi or NABARD partner banks.
6. Banks are mandated to issue the KCC card within 14 days of receiving a complete application.
application_mode: Public Sector Banks, RRBs, Cooperative Banks, Online Banking Portals

title: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Jal Shakti
benefit: Financial subsidy of 45% to 55% for installing micro-irrigation systems (Drip and Sprinkler systems) under 'Per Drop More Crop' (PDMC), drastically saving water and fertilizer costs while boosting yields.
eligibility: All categories of farmers having cultivable land and an assured water source are eligible. Small and marginal farmers receive higher subsidy assistance (up to 55%).
exclusions: Land with no accessible water source or where micro-irrigation subsidies were availed within the preceding 7 years on the same plot.
documents: Water source certificate / electricity connection bill for tube-well/well
Soil and water testing report (if requested by district office)
how_to_apply_steps: 1. Ensure you have cultivable land with a functional water source (borewell, open well, or farm pond).
2. Visit the official PMKSY / PDMC portal or your state's Horticulture/Agriculture department portal (e.g., Mahadbt in MH, UP Agriculture, or state DBTs).
3. Register using your Aadhaar and mobile number, then select the 'Micro Irrigation (Drip/Sprinkler)' component.
4. Choose an empanelled manufacturer/supplier and submit the online application.
5. An agricultural officer or field surveyor will conduct a pre-inspection of the farm plot.
6. Upon approval, the system is installed, post-inspection is completed, and the subsidy is credited directly via DBT.
application_mode: State DBT Agriculture Portals & District Horticulture Offices

title: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefit: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market. Enables transparent price discovery, competitive bidding from national buyers, and online digital payment settlement directly to farmer accounts.
eligibility: Any Indian farmer producing agricultural commodities desiring to trade through connected APMC mandis.
exclusions: None for individual farmers selling their own produce.
documents: Mobile number for SMS lot alerts and OTPs
Mandi gate entry slip upon commodity arrival
how_to_apply_steps: 1. Open the official e-NAM portal (enam.gov.in) and click on 'Registration'.
2. Select Registration Type as 'Farmer' and choose your State and local APMC Mandi.
3. Enter your Name, Mobile Number, Aadhaar Number, and Bank details for direct payments.
4. Alternatively, register directly at the registration counter / gate entry of any e-NAM integrated APMC Mandi.
5. Bring your produce to the mandi gate to receive a lot identification tag with digital weighing and quality assaying.
6. Watch live e-bidding online; approve the highest bid to receive electronic payment directly into your bank account within 24 hours.
application_mode: Online Web Portal, e-NAM Mobile App, APMC Mandi Registration Counters

title: PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000/ha is directly provided for organic inputs (bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides, neem cake, vermicompost) and remaining for PGS certification and value addition.
eligibility: Farmers willing to form clusters of 20 hectares or 50 farmers to practice certified organic farming without chemical inputs.
exclusions: Individual farmers with isolated plots unable to form or join an organic cluster under PGS-India standards.
documents: Bank account details linked to Aadhaar
how_to_apply_steps: 1. Form or join a group of nearby farmers forming a 20-50 hectare contiguous cluster.
2. Contact the local Block Agriculture Officer (BAO) or District Nodal Officer for PKVY.
3. Register the cluster on the Jaivik Kheti portal (jaivikkheti.in) or PGS-India portal.
4. Formulate the cluster action plan and submit KYC details of all participating farmers.
5. Undergo training and baseline soil testing conducted by the regional council.
6. Receive input subsidies via DBT in phase milestones and obtain PGS-India Green / Organic certification.
application_mode: Cluster Formation via District Agriculture Office / Jaivik Kheti Portal
